effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon gets linked, if you have 1 or fewer Tamers, you may play 1 [Torajiro Asuka] from your hand without paying the cost.
link_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn.
